title: Pascals Triangle
description:
Given an integer numRows, return the first numRows of Pascal's triangle.
In Pascal's triangle, each number is the sum of the two numbers directly above it as shown:

 
Example 1:
Input: numRows = 5
Output: [[1],[1,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,3,1],[1,4,6,4,1]]
Example 2:
Input: numRows = 1
Output: [[1]]

 
Constraints:

1 <= numRows <= 30

check_function:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(numRows = 1) == [[1]]
    assert candidate(numRows = 2) == [[1],[1,1]]
    assert candidate(numRows = 3) == [[1],[1,1],[1,2,1]]
    assert candidate(numRows = 5) == [[1],[1,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,3,1],[1,4,6,4,1]]
    assert candidate(numRows = 6) == [[1],[1,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,3,1],[1,4,6,4,1],[1,5,10,10,5,1]]
    assert candidate(numRows = 0) == []
    assert candidate(numRows = 7)[-1] == [1,6,15,20,15,6,1]
    assert candidate(numRows = 4)[2] == [1,2,1]
